items.title: Marian McPartland — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: but I’ve met him, and he just seems very self-assured and jolly

ctx.x: [laughs]. Or would you recognize him if you did see him?

I probably wouldn’t. Actually he’s a very nice guy. Not that they shouldn’t be nice, but I’ve met him, and he just seems very self-assured and jolly, and he must like his life. He just must be happy doing what he’s doing.
Sounds like we’ve covered most of . . . what about one other question. On your mother’s side, does she have siblings?
